text: Kiran Rehman holds account PK**ABPA****5563 opened on 31 January 2022. The subject is a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month. Between 3 August 2026 and 9 August 2026, the account received 15 credits totalling PKR 830,000 and made 3 debits totalling PKR 784,000. All 15 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 14 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 9 August 2026, scoring a Tazama typology MULE-01 of 360 against a threshold of 300. The presence of 14 distinct inbound senders in a short period is indicative of the many unrelated inbound senders red flag. Debits equal to 94% of credits with a median of 3.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit suggests most inbound value leaves the account within hours. Credits in the activity window were 27.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month, inconsistent with the subject's Student profile. These patterns are consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 472,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. PKR 312,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. Screening on 29 August 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
